soc.tie_advancement_state_tree.assessment: Earlier audit flagged DUPLICATE_OF soc.second_leg_aggregate_state because the state multipliers were defined in both. Rebutted in part: the rule-table composition is distinct (it is what separates a single-leg cup tie, a two-leg tie and a straight-to-penalties tie); the overlap is removed by narrowing the definition so the multipliers live only in the aggregate-state input. The catalog audit_flag still says DUPLICATE until the orchestrator regenerates it.
soc.tie_advancement_state_tree.measurement_fix: Tie-rule composition layer, not a second copy of the aggregate state: the state multipliers (trailing/leader risk posture, aggregate deficit) are read from soc.second_leg_aggregate_state, which is the only place they are estimated; this input adds the competition-season rule table (single leg vs two legs, extra time played or straight to penalties, no away-goals rule) and composes P(advance) = P(aggregate win in 90) + P(aggregate level) * (P(ET win) + P(pens win)) from that table, with shrinkage k=40 ties per competition and as-of prior seasons only.
raw_data: tie results with leg scores, ET, penalties

sources.name: worldfootball.net / Wikipedia / RSSSF
sources.note: Results, goal minutes, lineups, shootouts for cups and internationals

soc.european_slot_spillover.assessment: Earlier audit flagged DUPLICATE_OF soc.tiebreaker_rules. Rebutted in part: the rule table is static, whereas the spillover probability is a simulation output that changes after each cup round and decides KXEPLTOP4-type qualification wording; the overlap is removed by narrowing this definition to the stochastic part. Context only. The catalog audit_flag still says DUPLICATE until the orchestrator regenerates it.
soc.european_slot_spillover.measurement_fix: Stochastic spillover only: the static allocation rules (base UEFA places by coefficient, cup-winner replacement, title-holder entry) are read from soc.tiebreaker_rules and not re-encoded here; this input adds the simulated probability E that a domestic cup winner already holds a higher European slot, from the cup simulation, giving the effective cut line L = base - E for top-N and qualification series; recompute after each cup round with the as-of date stamped.
